parameters.query:
INSERT INTO webhook_logs (provider, idempotency_key, payload, status, received_at, workflow_version)
VALUES ('superchat', $1, $2::jsonb, 'pending', now(), 'superchat_ig_v1')
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL
DO UPDATE SET id = webhook_logs.id
RETURNING id, (xmax = 0) AS is_new;

SELECT (array_agg(c.id))[1] AS clinic_id,
       (array_agg(ch.id))[1] AS channel_id,
       COUNT(*)::int AS match_count
FROM clinics c
JOIN channels ch ON ch.clinic_id = c.id
WHERE ch.provider = 'superchat'
  AND ch.type = 'instagram'
  AND ch.status = 'connected'
  AND ch.is_enabled = true
  AND ch.config->>'superchat_channel_id' = $1
GROUP BY ch.config->>'superchat_channel_id'
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COALESCE(cs.provider, c.provider) AS provider, cs.api_token AS api_token, cs.signing_secret AS signing_secret, cs.tenant_identifier AS tenant_identifier
FROM channels c
LEFT JOIN get_channel_secret_db(c.id) cs ON true
WHERE c.id = $1::uuid

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $("Merge Patient Data SUPERCHAT").item.json.clinic_id, $("Merge Patient Data SUPERCHAT").item.json.patient_id, $("Merge Patient Data SUPERCHAT").item.json.channel_id, $("Merge Patient Data SUPERCHAT").item.json.channel_patient_id ] }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE webhook_logs
SET status = 'processed',
    clinic_id = $1,
    channel_id = $2,
    processing_time_ms = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - received_at)) * 1000
WHERE id = $3
  AND status = 'pending'
  AND clinic_id IS NULL
  AND channel_id IS NULL
  AND idempotency_key = $4
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Merge Conversation Data SUPERCHAT').item.json.clinic_id, $('Merge Conversation Data SUPERCHAT').item.json.channel_id, $('Log Webhook SUPERCHAT').item.json.id, $('Parse SUPERCHAT Message').item.json.idempotency_key ] }}

nodes.notes: Creates an HMAC over the exact internal core envelope using the encrypted channel secret; never emits the secret.

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ JSON.stringify($('Build K2 Signed Core Envelope').item.json.core_payload || {}), String($('Build K2 Signed Core Envelope').item.json.channel_id) ] }}

parameters.query: SELECT encode(extensions.hmac($1::text, secret.signing_secret, 'sha256'), 'hex') AS signature FROM public.get_channel_secret_db($2::uuid) AS secret WHERE secret.signing_secret IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1;
